news.title: Metro Line 1 services hit after technical snag near Saki Naka
news.summary: Commuters on the Versova-Ghatkopar Metro Line 1 faced delays on Tuesday evening after a train halted near Saki Naka due to a technical issue. Services are running with delays.

news.title: Signal failure delays Western Railway slow locals at Andheri
news.summary: Slow local services on the Western line were running 15-20 minutes late in the evening peak after a signal failure near Andheri. Fast services were unaffected.

news.title: Metro 3 Aqua Line records highest weekday ridership
news.summary: The Aqua Line carried a record number of passengers on Monday, officials said.

news.title: Central Railway announces Sunday mega block between Matunga and Mulund
news.summary: A mega block on the up and down fast lines between Matunga and Mulund will be operated on Sunday 25 October from 11:05 to 15:55.
